Wondrous Item (Artifact), requires attunement

A black steel helm adorned with crimson filigree and stylized bat-wing motifs. While worn, the interior remains pleasantly warm regardless of the surrounding temperature.

Only the wearer can hear the voice within.

The voice insists upon one undeniable truth:

"You are a vampire."

Any evidence to the contrary is immediately dismissed.

The Visage interprets every success as proof of the wearer's hidden vampiric nature and every failure as a temporary inconvenience suffered by an immortal being.

Dormant Powers

Eyes of the Night

You gain darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already possess darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.

Predatory Instinct

As a bonus action, invoke the Visage.

Choose one:

  • Athletics
  • Intimidation
  • Perception
  • Stealth

You gain advantage on the next ability check made using that skill within 1 minute.

Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Blood Will Tell

Once per long rest, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you instead drop to 1 hit point.

The Visage insists this is evidence of your immortal nature.

Noble Bearing

You gain proficiency in Persuasion. If already proficient, gain expertise instead.

Personality

"A common vampire mistake."

"Your bloodline remains impressive."

"That peasant was clearly intimidated."

"An ancient vampiric technique."

"You continue to exceed expectations."
